query.description: Device의 기존 Map 헤더 / 저장 작업 상태 / 건수 (저장 전 기존 데이터 확인)
query.commandtext: SELECT M.FACTORY, M.DEVICE_ID, M.TOP_STRUCTURE, M.GDS_FILE_NAME, M.GDS_SHA256, M.MAP_STATUS, M.CREATE_USER, TO_CHAR(M.CREATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATE_TIME, J.IMPORT_JOB_SEQ, J.JOB_STATUS, NVL(J.RECEIVED_SOURCE_COUNT, 0) AS SOURCE_COUNT, NVL(J.RECEIVED_PLACED_COUNT, 0) AS PLACED_COUNT, NVL(J.RECEIVED_POINT_COUNT, 0) AS POINT_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_MAP M LEFT JOIN TQP_GDS_IMPORT_JOB J ON J.FACTORY = M.FACTORY AND J.DEVICE_ID = M.DEVICE_ID WHERE M.FACTORY = :factory AND M.DEVICE_ID = :device_id

INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_MAP (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, TOP_STRUCTURE, GDS_FILE_NAME, GDS_SHA256, USER_UNIT, DATABASE_UNIT, MAP_STATUS, CREATE_USER) VALUES (:factory, :device_id, :top_structure, :gds_file_name, :gds_sha256, TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:user_unit), TO_BINARY_DOUBLE(:database_unit), 'DRAFT', :create_user)

query.description: 저장 확정된 DRAFT Map을 READY로 변경
query.commandtext: UPDATE TQP_GDS_MAP SET MAP_STATUS = 'READY', UPDATE_USER = :update_user, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id AND MAP_STATUS = 'DRAFT'

query.description: Device Map 헤더 삭제 (하위 LAYER / 저장 작업 / Chain 등은 FK CASCADE)
query.commandtext: DELETE FROM TQP_GDS_MAP WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND DEVICE_ID = :device_id

query.description: 조회 화면: READY Map이 있는 Factory / Device 목록
query.commandtext: SELECT FACTORY, DEVICE_ID FROM TQP_GDS_MAP WHERE MAP_STATUS = 'READY' ORDER BY FACTORY, DEVICE_ID
